assets.headline: シンプルな表示
assets.source: C:/Users/ponta/Downloads/無題のフォルダ-20261008T123830Z-1-001/無題のフォルダ/タイムライン.jpg
assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing, ads-marketing.
Asset type: one Google Play listing screenshot for Nagisa, an Android Mastodon client.
This is a faithful marketing frame around an existing REAL screenshot, NOT a redesign or a recreated UI.
Input image 1: the actual screenshot to embed. Embed the screenshot itself as a single unchanged image layer, as if directly pasted into the layout. Preserve every app label, Japanese character, username, post, photo, emoji, icon, color, spacing, card, dialog, and navigation element exactly. Do not redraw or retype the screenshot content. No invented interface. The source's app UI MUST remain intact and recognizable.
Only crop away the Android system status bar at the very top (clock, VPN, Bluetooth, signal, battery) and bottom system gesture bar; preserve the app's own toolbar and bottom navigation.
New outer canvas: EXACTLY 1152 x 2048 pixels, vertical 9:16, opaque RGB.
Visual system for all four images: very pale lavender background #F0ECF8, subtle soft blue-lavender glow near the bottom, dark violet headline #28213B. Flat, restrained, clean Japanese app-store design. No illustrations, decorations, device mockups, hardware bezels, perspective, tilted screens, numbering, watermarks, badges, arrows, extra slogans or branding text.
Typography: crisp large bold Japanese sans-serif, 72 px equivalent. Headline left aligned at x=96, vertically centered within the upper 300 px. For long headlines, break into two natural lines without changing or adding any character.
Screenshot: centered below the headline, starting near y=330, occupying most of the remaining canvas; preserve its original aspect ratio, fit fully with generous side margins (roughly 150 px), no stretch, no clipping of app controls. Add only a delicate shadow and subtle 20 px rounded outer corners around the screenshot. The app UI remains as large and legible as possible. No extra copy.
Text (verbatim), the ONLY new text outside the embedded screenshot: "シンプルな表示".

Source image role: light-theme home timeline. Keep its theme and all original app content unchanged. Produce only this one finished portrait poster.
